title: Montserrat scanned and found to carry a tridactyl fetus

tellings.quote: So, right now they're showing us the moment exact moment they discovered that she was pregnant when they were doing the scans because it happens live, so that's what they're showing us right now.

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, says that while visiting Peru in the 2020s he was shown footage of scans of "Montserrat", one of several small mummified bodies with three fingers on each hand found there. He says the footage captured the exact moment the scanners discovered she was carrying a fetus, live as it happened. If true, it would mean these three-fingered beings could reproduce, like a real species.
